subject: executor: add hash join v2 (#53208)
summary: Adds a new Hash Join V2 implementation in `pkg/executor/join` (guarded by the test-only `join.EnableHashJoinV2` flag and `PhysicalHashJoin.CanUseHashJoinV2()`), refactors existing hash join into V1 plus shared base helpers, and introduces supporting chunk/codec utilities for V2’s row-table-based probing/building. No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantic/concurrency issues identified in the production path (Hash Join V1 remains the default).
